decisions.reason: As a classic handle line in the firm's core hardware business it still fits the assortment, but two years without visible website presence raise a meaningful risk of quiet portfolio rationalization.
This lever-handle family supports the firm's broad specification offer for architects and developers, so it is worth retaining unless overlap with newer ranges has become too high.
A single handle design is easier to discontinue than a full family, and after no recent market visibility the firm would likely prune it to free resources for stronger ranges and new development.
Because it is only a design variant close to many established products, the absence of recent visibility makes withdrawal more likely than continued active support.
A multi-model lever-handle family remains useful for covering different project requirements and price points, so a large German supplier would usually keep it unless it has been clearly superseded.

The digital access category is strategic, but this specific 2018 flagship system is technologically more likely to be replaced or absorbed into a newer platform after disappearing from recent website communication.
